findings.description: Retrieved https://www.ece.uh.edu/faculty at 2026-11-25T02:45:06+00:00 (response sha256 a65e95ec...). Enumerated all eight main/section headings and the Joint, Adjunct and Emeritus sections: 104 cards matched the 104 brief people by normalized name (honorifics and credentials removed); no omissions and no people on the page missing from the brief.

Section counts from the list: Department Chair 1; Associate Department Chair 2; Professor 16; Associate Professor 10; Assistant Professor 7; Research Professor 2; Research Associate Professor 1; Research Assistant Professor 3; Instructional Faculty 4; Professor Emeritus 4; Joint Appointment 23; Adjunct Appointment 25; Emeritus Faculty 6.

Joint Appointment cards on the list show name and contact lines only, with no profile link or title. Ranks and ECE joint links for these 23 people were taken from the official UH, ET, BME, CS, ME, IST, CEE, HPEDSI, Profiles RNS and personal pages downloaded in this audit (sources listed per record).

Profile retrieval notes: https://math.uh.edu/~onofrei returned HTTP 404 (not cited). https://www.cee.uh.edu/faculty/glennie-craig, https://www.uh.edu/nsm/computer-science/people/faculty/profiles/glennie.php and https://www.ece.uh.edu/faculty/fan (and two Robles Hernandez ECE guesses) returned 404 or non-profile pages and were not cited. Adjunct and emeritus profile pages were not fetched (excluded by section).
Hao Huang is listed under the Professor heading, but his card title is "Distinguished Adjunct Professor" (per the brief). Decided excluded (adjunct), not regular.
Houston Methodist profile (s2) says Research Professor at the University of Houston in the ECE department. Excluded research_only per the brief instruction.

owner determination 2026-11-25: the owner states he is an Assistant Professor (revised determination, 2026-11-25). Decided joint_secondary / ece / current, with rank recorded as Assistant Professor in the rationale; no downloaded official page states his rank.

Joseph Francis: The ECE link comes only from the department own Joint Appointment list (s1); his BME profile lists no ECE appointment. Convention applied; would become unresolved only if the department list were shown not to be its own roster. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.
Craig L Glennie: Rank from HPEDSI profile (Professor, CEE); CEE list gives only the Cullen chair title. ECE link only from s1. Convention applied. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.
Kirill Larin: BME profile gives Cullen Endowed Chair and Professor; no ECE line on the BME profile. ECE link only from s1. Convention applied. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.
Zhifeng Ren: Physics professor and endowed chair; no ECE line on the physics source. ECE link only from s1. Convention applied. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.

Francisco C Robles Hernandez: ET profile gives Professor, Mechanical Engineering Technology; no ECE line on that profile. ECE link only from s1. Convention applied. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.
Venkat Selvamanickam: ME profile gives M.D. Anderson Chair Professor (ME); no ECE line on the ME profile. ECE link only from s1. Convention applied. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.
Renjie Hu: IST profile gives Assistant Professor (CIS); no ECE line on that profile. ECE link only from s1. Convention applied. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.

Lei Fan: Two professorial ranks on the same ET profile (header Associate Professor; biography assistant professor). Both are professorial, so the decision does not depend on which is current. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.

Ahmad Sakhaee-Pour: Profiles RNS lists Assistant Professor (older); the Petroleum Engineering profile lists Associate Professor and an ECE joint appointment 2026-present. Newer official listing used; both are professorial. Decided joint_secondary / ece / current.
